scope: HUG only; one existing cube seed-0 saved native and nominal Shadow configuration
grid_rule: Centered square cell grids on all six faces of the actual centered axis-aligned 50 mm cube; excludes face edges
global_metric: Occupied-or-near: inside the globally closed native mesh or any compatible Shadow collider, or globally exterior unsigned nearest-surface distance within band; negative per-geom minimum is not union penetration depth
anatomical_metric: Independent per-part unsigned nearest triangle/collider surface proximity within band. Native parts are open triangle subsets and never used for occupancy
native_part_labels: Group weights into palm/index/middle/ring/little/thumb; argmax group per vertex; majority vote over three triangle vertices; if all differ, highest mean grouped weight among tied labels; record mixed/tied triangles and query ambiguity
shadow_part_labels: Actual finger body prefixes; palm; forearm and wrist separate carrier categories
paired_normal_queries: Cube-face cell centers globally exterior to both hands, within the diagnostic band of both globally nearest surfaces, and with equal nearest anatomical labels; report mismatch/lost/new separately
closest_surface_analysis: Unsigned closest-point separation and unit geometric normal angle; separate both/one/neither closest point strictly inside cube; normals are not forces or paired contacts
empty_sets: Null statistics and undefined IoU rather than zero errors
required_invariants: Saved object qpos and world pose unchanged
Actual object collider and pair filters inspected
allowed_operations: Read existing native parameters and mesh
forbidden_operations: New grasps, task labels or evaluation dataset
limitations: No proof of native self-intersection absence
Collision geometry differs from native surface
No fidelity pass threshold or physical contact-force equivalence
